name: Arahal (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue, charged at the centre with the arms of Arahal (a tower and a tree on yellow, timbred with a helmet).
history: The flag is rectangular with three equal horizontal stripes, the upper and lower blue and the central white with the arms of the town; the town lacked an official flag until the 1970s, when this one was adopted alluding to the Immaculist colours.

features.role: Arahal arms — tower and tree on yellow, timbred with a helmet
